name: Block Grep
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: _gid
description: Highlights every occurrence of a block pattern near you.
works: Client-side search for block patterns near you: /blockgrep pattern <spec> adds one, the mod scans the loaded chunks and outlines every match; /blockgrep status reports the match count.
note: Not yet: Its pattern screen doesn't open under Kiln, its two keys have no default, and the outlines in the world aren't checked here.
